summary: Approved as readable, behavior-validated unmatched C++ with zero matching-source byte credit.
reason: Reviewed every submitted source/header, metadata, validation, reference assembly and documentation. ABI, layouts, signed HRESULT branches, output writes, live dependency reloads and partial cleanup agree with original evidence. Independently verified the 189-byte oracle against Game.exe and passed mapped original differential tests, including an O2 run through the actual create entry. Tests cover failure paths, output/null masks, callback mutations, call order and complete guarded state. Native Windows compilation records cover the actual implementation but establish no matching credit. Sampled tests do not prove all-input equivalence; documented external-operation, fault, exception and concurrency limits remain.
